name: Ginger
source:
Ginger is as straight forward as they come. What you see is what you get.

This redhead is cheerful, happy, outgoing, and fun... not a lot of mystery, just plain fun and excitement.

Talk to her, go on a date, be friends, and who knows, it may lead to something else! :D
